name: Black Ace
description: The Black Ace was a modified TIE/ln space superiority starfighter piloted by Griff Halloran. Halloran used it both as a racer and in the defense of the Colossus. The ship was lost for a short time during the Platform Classic, but was later recovered and used later in the attack on Bibo's mother.

data.name: Black Ace
data.type: Heavily modified TIE/ln space superiority starfighter
